security.title: Security First
security.description: How we secure your account, protect your data, and keep both taskers and taskees safe on our platform.

security_approach.title: Our Security Approach
security_approach.description: BitTasker takes a fundamentally different approach to security compared to traditional platforms. Instead of asking you to trust us with your sensitive information, we have built systems where you maintain control of your own security.
security_approach.alert_text: While we implement industry-standard security measures, no system is completely immune to security risks. Users are responsible for following security best practices and maintaining the security of their own devices and accounts. BitTasker cannot guarantee absolute security and is not liable for security breaches resulting from user negligence or third-party vulnerabilities.

security_passkeys.title: Passkeys, Not Passwords
security_passkeys.description: We've implemented passkey authentication, which provides enhanced security compared to traditional passwords. Passkeys use public-key cryptography to create unique authentication credentials that remain on your device.
security_passkeys.point_2: No shared secrets stored on our servers
security_passkeys.alert_text: Passkey security depends on your device's security. Keep your device updated and secure to maintain the effectiveness of this authentication method.

security_recovery.title: Account Recovery System
security_recovery.description: We provide email-based recovery options for situations where passkeys become inaccessible. Our recovery system is designed to balance security with accessibility.
security_recovery.alert_text: Account recovery security depends on your email security. Use strong email security practices and two-factor authentication on your recovery email account.

security_encryption.title: Client-Side Encryption
security_encryption.description: Your Bitcoin wallet and Nostr private keys are encrypted on your device using your authentication credentials before synchronization with our servers.
security_encryption.point_1: Keys are stored in encrypted format
security_encryption.point_2: BitTasker does not have access to your private keys
security_encryption.alert_text: If you lose access to your authentication credentials, we cannot recover your encrypted keys. Maintain secure backups of your recovery information.

security_wallet.title: Bitcoin Wallet Security
security_wallet.description: BitTasker provides an integrated wallet designed for platform transactions. This wallet is intended for active use rather than long-term storage of significant Bitcoin amounts.
security_wallet.point_1: Withdrawal capabilities maintained for user control
security_wallet.point_2: No imposed withdrawal limitations under normal operation
security_wallet.point_3: Transaction signing occurs on your device
security_wallet.point_4: Designed for convenience in platform transactions
security_wallet.alert_text: As with any hot wallet, we recommend transferring larger Bitcoin amounts to cold storage solutions when not actively using them. Hot wallets are inherently less secure than cold storage.

additional_security.title: Additional Security Measures
additional_security.identity_description: BitTasker leverages the Nostr protocol for decentralized identity management. Your identity is based on cryptographic key pairs that you control, rather than being stored in a central database.
additional_security.identity_alert: Your identity can be portable across applications that support the Nostr protocol. However, the security and reliability of this system depends on the broader Nostr network and relay infrastructure.
additional_security.escrow_description: The hirer locks Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, or Lightning in escrow. BitTasker cannot spend it. The hirer pays the worker's invoice after approving the work.
additional_security.escrow_alert: Bitcoin and Lightning payments are final once they are sent. There is no automatic refund timer. Cancel while the contract is still open and unpaid if you need to stop.
additional_security.privacy_description: BitTasker implements end-to-end encryption for private messages between users, designed so that BitTasker cannot read your conversations.
additional_security.privacy_alert: Message security depends on the proper implementation of encryption protocols and the security of the devices used for communication.

alert.title: Your security is primarily your responsibility.
alert.description: While BitTasker implements security measures, following these best practices is essential for protecting your account and funds. BitTasker cannot be held responsible for losses resulting from failure to follow security best practices.

recovery.title: Keep Your Recovery Information Secure
recovery.description: Store your recovery information in a secure password manager and ensure your recovery email account is protected with strong security measures. You are solely responsible for maintaining access to your recovery information.

cold_storage.title: Use Cold Storage for Large Bitcoin Holdings
cold_storage.description: While BitTasker's wallet implements security measures for platform transactions, we strongly recommend transferring larger Bitcoin amounts to hardware wallets or other cold storage solutions when not actively using them. Hot wallets are inherently less secure than cold storage.

transaction_verification.title: Verify Transaction Details Carefully
transaction_verification.description: Always double-check Bitcoin addresses and transaction amounts before confirming. Bitcoin transactions are irreversible, and BitTasker cannot recover funds sent to incorrect addresses or reverse confirmed transactions.

device_security.title: Keep Your Devices Secure
device_security.description: Since BitTasker relies on client-side security, keeping your devices free from malware and updated with the latest security patches is essential. Use reputable antivirus software and avoid accessing your account from public or compromised devices.

commitment.title: Our Security Commitment
commitment.description: BitTasker is committed to implementing and maintaining reasonable security practices as technology evolves. However, we cannot guarantee absolute security and users must take responsibility for their own security practices.
commitment.warning_text: No security system is perfect. BitTasker disclaims liability for security breaches caused by factors beyond our reasonable control, including but not limited to user negligence, third-party vulnerabilities, or sophisticated attacks.
commitment.question_description: We're here to help with security concerns and questions about our platform.
